notes.title: [(Ver. 1.0.1)Patch notes]
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of "The Caligula Effect 2".
We have released a patch that implements the following fixes and adjustments.
We apologize for causing an inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you could download the patch.

Adjustments
・"3840x2160" has been added to the preset resolution choices.
・ DualSense Wireless Controller (PS5 Wireless Controller) compatibility has been added.
・ The default resolution has been changed from 1280x720 to 1920x1080.

Bug fixes
・ Fixed an issue where the UI during battles would remain hidden
・ Fixed an issue where the game would crash upon start up on full screen mode, under certain circumstances.
・ Fixed an issue where the game would crash when closing the game.

notes.title: Guidelines for game images and gameplay videos (including live streams)
notes.content:
These guidelines stipulate the use of videos captured from the game The Caligula Effect 2 released on Steam by historia Inc.

 Terms of Use 

- Only individuals are granted permission for use. 

Note: For corporations or individuals belonging to corporations, please contact us separately via [url=https://historia.co.jp/contact]https://historia.co.jp/contact[/url]. 

 - Posting game strategy, introduction, playthrough, and explanatory videos on video hosting platforms and social media sites such as YouTube, Twitter, and Facebook is permitted. 

 - The company may not always hold the rights to music (including music in the game). - In such cases, it is the customer's responsibility to obtain permission from the rights holder. 

 - The following copyright declaration must be clearly displayed when uploading or streaming videos. 


[i][b]© FURYU Corporation. Licensed to and published by historia Inc. [/b][/i]


 - The company will not promote or license user submitted videos as official videos of the company. 

 - When uploading or streaming videos of the game, please take into consideration that the other customers will be anticipating a positive viewing experience. If scenes contain spoilers, please exercise care in indicating so. 

 - We will not respond to inquiries regarding these guidelines, support for uploaded videos, or details of evaluation criteria. 


The following uses are prohibited, even for personal use:

- Use for commercial purposes, such as publishing on websites or through services that require payment for viewing. 
Note: Monetization through an ad posting system on the video hosting platform is exempt and not treated as a commercial purpose. 

 - Posting or streaming videos that are not game playthrough videos, but are edited in a way that only feature cutscenes, music, or character voices. 

- Posting or streaming material containing third party IP rights without permission, offensive material, material slandering other companies, or material containing information that differs from that of officially announced information. 

 - Posting or streaming any other content the company deems inappropriate. 

We may, at our discretion, take legal action, which includes video deletion, if any video posted or streamed contains prohibited content. 

 Even if usage complies with these guidelines, the company cannot make any guarantee as to the results of posting, uploading, streaming, or any other secondary usage of images, videos, music, etc. 

Please note that posting or streaming videos that infringe on the rights of others, including the company's rights, may result in punitive measures being taken. Please ensure that usage is in accordance with laws, rules, and societal norms.
